original_source_plan: Record second-house cusp interval from original wording without inventing a numerical upper-bound interpretation.
Preserve second-house ruler, intercepted sign/ruler, Part of Fortune/ruler, Jupiter, occupying planets and distance from cusp as separate significators.
Separate Ptolemy attributed wealth-cause passages from Lilly's source narration and Leovitius/Origanus additions.
Preserve inheritance, work, social, religion, navigation and trade mechanisms without assuming human economic predictive validity.
Do not mistake the unnumbered introductory wealth section for printed CHAP CXIIII; full CXIIII and CXV deserve their own studies.
